EFS/S28.title: Kept drafts vs the device clock (probes efs-s28-draft-clock.spec.ts)
EFS/S28.detail: (a) clock 2 h behind: the tail written after the session ended is restored although it predates the server's save; (b) clock 2 h ahead: the stale tail overwrites/joins the newer text from the other session; (c) 19 h / 37 h (Hospital) and 13 h (Nursing Home) old tails are silently put into today's Encounter box. Same as before.
